LanguageData.Gun_MP-41_RWP.description: The MP-41 is a well-crafted submachine gun designed for reliability and ease of use. Combining rapid fire with reasonable accuracy, it excels in close to mid-range combat. Its wooden stock adds stability, making it a dependable choice for any colonist facing a firefight.
